text:
maya: heads-up — bringing in CKA-7B from an external repo. License looks like CC BY-NC + attribution required. Can we run quantized evals and potentially host on Dedicated? Need legal clarity before we add to the model catalog.

sam: can you paste the exact license text/clauses you saw?

maya: ```
License: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 (CC BY-NC 4.0)
Excerpt: 'No part of the licensed material may be used for commercial purposes.'
Attribution: required
Sublicense: not granted / ambiguous
```

legal-bot: Automated license scan results: detected tags = ["NonCommercial", "Attribution", "NoSublicense"]. Risk summary: redistribution prohibited / hosting-for-cost flagged. Suggested classification: restricted-hosting; escalate to legal for commercial use.

sam: short answer — NC almost always prohibits us from offering it in Hosted or Dedicated paid products. Internal evals for research are usually acceptable, but we cannot publish or distribute quantized weights or enable customer access without an explicit commercial license.

lex: engineering note — our quant pipeline currently writes intermediate artifacts to s3://redwood-models/ci-artifacts by default and creates downloadable quant files. For this model we must: (1) gate the pipeline so artifacts remain internal-only, (2) turn off automatic packaging/publish, (3) avoid any artifact that could be redistributed.

oliver: ops side — do NOT route this to Dedicated pools or list in Hosted catalog. I'll add an onboarding tag and network/KMS ACLs once we have the ticket. Also flag the model in the console UI as "restricted_hosting" so SE/CS can't accidentally expose it.

maya: actionables recap? :eyes:

sam: 1) Legal to request a commercial/dual license from the upstream owners (we should ask for explicit redistribution and sublicense rights). 2) Allow internal-only quant/eval runs on Private infra under NDA. 3) Block any creation of downloadable/redistributable artifacts. 4) Add a model-onboarding ticket and attach license scan output.

lex: I'll add a quick linter rule in the onboarding CI to block publish if license contains "NonCommercial" or "NoSublicense" and to require a "commercial_license_ok" flag. Patch target: model-onboarding repo.

maya: I'll open the ticket and attach the license snippet + scanner JSON. Tagging @sam @lex for review. Thanks! :+1:

oliver: I'll prepare an infra flag and restrict the s3 path, KMS policy, and console listing once the ticket exists.

sam: note: if upstream provides a paid/commercial license or a dual-license that allows redistribution, we can re-evaluate hosting and quantized-derivative policies. Until then treat as research-only.

maya: ack — proceeding with internal-only evals behind a feature flag, no artifact export, no customer-facing deployment. Will update ticket with perf/quality results.

(legal-bot): scan attached: /internal/license-scans/3087654321.json :white_check_mark:
